info.title: API.SH: PriceCharting
info.description: The PriceCharting API from API.SH: public PriceCharting data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
PriceCharting's big movers: the 100 items in a category whose price changed most, by amount or by percent, up or down: id, title, console or set, loose price, change and link. Video games can be narrowed to a region.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pricecharting-popular

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: video-games (default), coins, comic-books, funko-pops, pokemon-cards, dragon-ball-cards, lorcana-cards, magic-cards, marvel-cards, one-piece-cards, star-wars-cards, yugioh-cards, garbage-pail-cards, other-tcg-cards, other-cards or lego-sets.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: For video games: all, japan, ntsc or pal.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One PriceCharting item: current values for each condition or grade with their last change and sales volume, the full price guide (every grade such as PSA 10, BGS 10, CGC 10), monthly price history per condition, PSA and CGC population counts for cards, details (release date, publisher, card number, UPC, ids) and the recent sold listings per condition with date, title, price, link and marketplace (eBay, TCGplayer and others). Pass `url`, `id`, or `q` with `latest=true`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pricecharting-product

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A pricecharting.com/game/... link, or the console/item path such as pokemon-base-set/charizard-4.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Instead of url: the PriceCharting item id (id of a search result).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: With latest=true: search words; the first search result is used (category, region and sort also apply).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: use the first result of the search with q.

parameters.name: sales
parameters.description: false: leave out the sold listings.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search PriceCharting's price guide (video games, trading cards, comics, coins, Funko Pops, LEGO sets): items with their console or set, image and the site's three headline values (`price_1`..`price_3`: loose / complete / new for games, ungraded / grade 9 / PSA 10 for cards). Up to 200 matches; page with `page` and `limit`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pricecharting-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every item of a PriceCharting console or card set (e.g. nintendo-64, pokemon-base-set) with its three headline values and the latest price change, 150 per page. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pricecharting-set

parameters.name: console
parameters.description: Console or set slug (the part after /console/ in a pricecharting.com link) or the link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
